notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

uses.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
